mapper.select: WITH trace_lock AS ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(concat(#{ncn}, ':', to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDD')))) ), next_trace AS ( SELECT coalesce(max(trace_seq), 0) + 1 AS trace_seq FROM smartform.msf_service_alter_trace WHERE ncn = #{ncn} AND reg_date = to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDD') ) INSERT INTO smartform.msf_service_alter_trace ( ncn, trace_seq, cret_ip, cret_dt, cret_id, amd_ip, amd_dt, amd_id, global_no, contract_num, subscriber_no, event_cd, prcs_mdl_div_cd, trtm_rslt_sbst, prcs_sbst, rslt_cd, a_soc_code, t_soc_code, a_soc_amt, t_soc_amt, parameter, access_ip, access_url_adr, user_id, reg_date ) SELECT #{ncn}, next_trace.trace_seq, #{accessIp}, now(), #{userId}, #{accessIp}, now(), #{userId}, #{globalNo}, #{contractNum}, #{subscriberNo}, #{eventCd}, #{prcsMdlDivCd}, #{trtmRsltSbst}, #{prcsSbst}, #{rsltCd}, #{aSocCode}, #{tSocCode}, #{aSocAmt}, #{tSocAmt}, #{parameter}, #{accessIp}, #{accessUrlAdr}, #{userId}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDD') FROM next_trace, trace_lock RETURNING ncn, reg_date AS regDate, trace_seq AS traceSeq

SELECT count(1) FROM smartform.msf_service_alter_trace WHERE ncn = #{ncn} AND t_soc_code = #{targetSocCode} AND cret_dt > now() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND reg_date = to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDD') AND event_cd = 'FIN' AND trtm_rslt_sbst = 'SUCCESS'
